name: Green Dragon’s Woodland Step
body:
You gain the green dragon’s ability to move through natural foliage.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic bloodline (must choose green dragon), 1st-level Dragon Disciple

Benefit: You can move through any sort of foliage at full speed without taking damage or suffering impairment. Areas of foliage that have been magically manipulated affect you normally. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to Survival checks.
